title: China Dialects Map
synopsis: Explore the mysteries of China’s seven main dialect groups and feel the unique charm of the Northern, Cantonese, and Wu dialects.

fullText.simplified:
中国方言地图

    你可能觉得，学汉语和跟中国人聊天是很难的事，但你可能不知道，其实中国人和中国人聊天有时候也很难。因为除了普通话，中国还有很多方言。如果两个人说不同的方言，也都不会说普通话，那么他们只能写字了，因为不同地方的方言太不一样了。
    那么，中国有多少方言呢？总的来说，有七大种。
    北方方言是最主要的方言，四分之三的中国人都在说北方方言。北方方言跟普通话很像，所以别担心，大部分中国人说的话，你都可以听懂。北方方言还有四种：河北-东北方言、西北方言、西南方言和江淮方言。说江淮方言的人住在长江北边，最简单的北方方言是河北-东北方言。
    广东话也是很多中国人会用的方言。在中国广东、广西一些地方、香港和澳门，人们都说广东话，很多住在国外的中国人和他们的孩子也说广东话。在国外的一些地方，可能说广东话的中国人比说普通话的中国人还多。广东话有九个声调，所以要想学好广东话不简单。
    吴方言是一种南方方言。说吴方言的人主要住在长江南边，最有名的吴方言是上海话。上海话听起来很软，别的地方的吴方言也是这样的。和广东话一样，北方人也听不懂吴方言。但是对日本人来说，吴方言不太难，因为日语有些词和吴方言很像。
    除了这三种方言，中国还有湘方言、赣方言、客家方言和闽方言。说这四种方言的人主要都住在南方。这是因为中国南方有很多山，以前的人们很难见面，慢慢就有了不同的方言。
    这就是中国的方言，听起来很难。但是总的来说，中国人和中国人是可以聊天的，大部分年轻人都会说普通话。
fullText.traditional:
中國方言地圖

    你可能覺得，學漢語和跟中國人聊天是很難的事，但你可能不知道，其實中國人和中國人聊天有時候也很難。因為除了普通話，中國還有很多方言。如果兩個人說不同的方言，也都不會說普通話，那麼他們只能寫字了，因為不同地方的方言太不一樣了。
    那麼，中國有多少方言呢？總的來說，有七大種。
    北方方言是最主要的方言，四分之三的中國人都在說北方方言。北方方言跟普通話很像，所以別擔心，大部分中國人說的話，你都可以聽懂。北方方言還有四種：河北-東北方言、西北方言、西南方言和江淮方言。說江淮方言的人住在長江北邊，最簡單的北方方言是河北-東北方言。
    廣東話也是很多中國人會用的方言。在中國廣東、廣西一些地方、香港和澳門，人們都說廣東話，很多住在國外的中國人和他們的孩子也說廣東話。在國外的一些地方，可能說廣東話的中國人比說普通話的中國人還多。廣東話有九個聲調，所以要想學好廣東話不簡單。
    吳方言是一種南方方言。說吳方言的人主要住在長江南邊，最有名的吳方言是上海話。上海話聽起來很軟，別的地方的吳方言也是這樣的。和廣東話一樣，北方人也聽不懂吳方言。但是對日本人來說，吳方言不太難，因為日語有些詞和吳方言很像。
    除了這三種方言，中國還有湘方言、贛方言、客家方言和閩方言。說這四種方言的人主要都住在南方。這是因為中國南方有很多山，以前的人們很難見面，慢慢就有了不同的方言。
    這就是中國的方言，聽起來很難。但是總的來說，中國人和中國人是可以聊天的，大部分年輕人都會說普通話。

sentences.traditional: 說江淮方言的人住在長江北邊，

sentences.simplified: 最简单的北方方言是河北-东北方言。
sentences.traditional: 最簡單的北方方言是河北-東北方言。
sentences.pinyin: zuì jiǎn dān de běi fāng fāng yán shì hé běi dōng běi fāng yán
sentences.english: People who speak the Jianghuai dialect live in the north of the Yangtze River.
The easiest Northern dialect is the Hebei-Northeastern dialect.

sentences.traditional: 廣東話也是很多中國人會用的方言。

sentences.traditional: 在中國廣東、廣西一些地方、香港和澳門，人們都說廣東話，
sentences.pinyin: zài zhōng guó guǎng dōng guǎng xī yì xiē dì fang xiāng gǎng hé ào mén rén men dōu shuō guǎng dōng huà
sentences.english: Cantonese is also a dialect spoken by many Chinese people.

sentences.simplified: 很多住在国外的中国人和他们的孩子也说广东话。
sentences.traditional: 很多住在國外的中國人和他們的孩子也說廣東話。
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō zhù zài guó wài de zhōng guó rén hé tā men de hái zi yě shuō guǎng dōng huà
sentences.english: In some places in China’s Guangdong, Guangxi, as well as Hong Kong and Macau, people speak Cantonese.

sentences.simplified: 在国外的一些地方，可能说广东话的中国人比说普通话的中国人还多。
sentences.traditional: 在國外的一些地方，可能說廣東話的中國人比說普通話的中國人還多。
sentences.pinyin: zài guó wài de yì xiē dì fang kě néng shuō guǎng dōng huà de zhōng guó rén bǐ shuō pǔ tōng huà de zhōng guó rén hái duō
sentences.english: Many Chinese people living overseas and their children also speak Cantonese.

sentences.simplified: 广东话有九个声调，所以要想学好广东话不简单。
sentences.traditional: 廣東話有九個聲調，所以要想學好廣東話不簡單。
sentences.pinyin: guǎng dōng huà yǒu jiǔ ge shēng diào suǒ yǐ yào xiǎng xué hǎo guǎng dōng huà bù jiǎn dān
sentences.english: In some places overseas, there might be more Chinese people who speak Cantonese than those who speak Putonghua.
Cantonese has nine tones, so if you want to learn Cantonese well, it is not easy.

sentences.simplified: 吴方言是一种南方方言。
sentences.traditional: 吳方言是一種南方方言。
sentences.pinyin: wú fāng yán shì yì zhǒng nán fāng fāng yán

sentences.simplified: 说吴方言的人主要住在长江南边，最有名的吴方言是上海话。
sentences.traditional: 說吳方言的人主要住在長江南邊，最有名的吳方言是上海話。
sentences.pinyin: shuō wú fāng yán de rén zhǔ yào zhù zài cháng jiāng nán bian zuì yǒu míng de wú fāng yán shì shàng hǎi huà
sentences.english: The Wu dialects are a type of Southern dialect.

sentences.simplified: 上海话听起来很软，别的地方的吴方言也是这样的。
sentences.traditional: 上海話聽起來很軟，別的地方的吳方言也是這樣的。

sentences.english: People who speak Wu dialects mainly live south of the Yangtze River. The most well-known Wu dialect is Shanghainese.

sentences.simplified: 和广东话一样，北方人也听不懂吴方言。
sentences.traditional: 和廣東話一樣，北方人也聽不懂吳方言。
sentences.pinyin: hé guǎng dōng huà yí yàng běi fāng rén yě tīng bù dǒng wú fāng yán
sentences.english: Shanghainese sounds very soft. Wu dialects in other places are also like this.

sentences.simplified: 但是对日本人来说，吴方言不太难，因为日语有些词和吴方言很像。
sentences.traditional: 但是對日本人來說，吳方言不太難，因為日語有些詞和吳方言很像。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì duì rì běn rén lái shuō wú fāng yán bù tài nán yīn wèi rì yǔ yǒu xiē cí hé wú fāng yán hěn xiàng
sentences.english: Just like Cantonese, northerners can’t understand the Wu dialects.
But for Japanese people, Wu dialects are not too difficult, because some words sound very similar in Japanese.

sentences.simplified: 除了这三种方言，中国还有湘方言、赣方言、客家方言和闽方言。
sentences.traditional: 除了這三種方言，中國還有湘方言、贛方言、客家方言和閩方言。

sentences.simplified: 说这四种方言的人主要都住在南方。
sentences.traditional: 說這四種方言的人主要都住在南方。
sentences.pinyin: shuō zhè sì zhǒng fāng yán de rén zhǔ yào dōu zhù zài nán fāng
sentences.english: Other than these three groups of dialects, China also has the Xiang dialect, Gan dialect, Hakka dialect, and Min dialect.

sentences.simplified: 这是因为中国南方有很多山，
sentences.traditional: 這是因為中國南方有很多山，
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì yīn wèi zhōng guó nán fāng yǒu hěn duō shān
sentences.english: People who speak these four dialects mainly live in the south.

sentences.simplified: 以前的人们很难见面，慢慢就有了不同的方言。
sentences.traditional: 以前的人們很難見面，慢慢就有了不同的方言。
sentences.pinyin: yǐ qián de rén men hěn nán jiàn miàn màn man jiù yǒu le bù tóng de fāng yán
sentences.english: This is because southern China is very mountainous.
In the past, it was very difficult for people to meet, so gradually, different dialects developed.

sentences.simplified: 这就是中国的方言，听起来很难。
sentences.traditional: 這就是中國的方言，聽起來很難。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiù shì zhōng guó de fāng yán tīng qǐ lái hěn nán

sentences.simplified: 但是总的来说，中国人和中国人是可以聊天的，大部分年轻人都会说普通话。
sentences.traditional: 但是總的來說，中國人和中國人是可以聊天的，大部分年輕人都會說普通話。

sentences.english: These are the dialects of China. It sounds quite complicated.

You might think that learning Chinese and talking to Chinese people is very difficult.
But you may not know that, in fact, Chinese people talking to other Chinese people is also sometimes very difficult.
Because in addition to Putonghua, China has many other dialects.
If two people speak different dialects and neither speaks Putonghua, ..
.. then they will have to communicate in writing because the dialects in different places are very different.
So, how many dialects does China have? Generally speaking, there are seven main groups.
The northern dialects are the most common dialects. Three out of four Chinese people speak Northern dialects.
The Northern dialects are very similar to Putonghua, ..
.. so don’t worry, you will be able to understand what the majority of Chinese people are saying.
There are four types of Northern dialects:
The Hebei-Northeastern dialect, the Northwestern dialect, the Southwestern dialect, and the Jianghuai dialect.
People who speak the Jianghuai dialect live in the north of the Yangtze River.
The easiest Northern dialect is the Hebei-Northeastern dialect.
Cantonese is also a dialect spoken by many Chinese people.
In some places in China’s Guangdong, Guangxi, as well as Hong Kong and Macau, people speak Cantonese.
Many Chinese people living overseas and their children also speak Cantonese.
In some places overseas, there might be more Chinese people who speak Cantonese than those who speak Putonghua.
Cantonese has nine tones, so if you want to learn Cantonese well, it is not easy.
The Wu dialects are a type of Southern dialect.
People who speak Wu dialects mainly live south of the Yangtze River. The most well-known Wu dialect is Shanghainese.
Shanghainese sounds very soft. Wu dialects in other places are also like this.
Just like Cantonese, northerners can’t understand the Wu dialects.
But for Japanese people, Wu dialects are not too difficult, because some words sound very similar in Japanese.
Other than these three groups of dialects, China also has the Xiang dialect, Gan dialect, Hakka dialect, and Min dialect.
People who speak these four dialects mainly live in the south.
This is because southern China is very mountainous.
In the past, it was very difficult for people to meet, so gradually, different dialects developed.
These are the dialects of China. It sounds quite complicated.
